description: This PHP source file defines the UserMigrationStatus class that manages migration process tracking and logging, including counters for processed, migrated, skipped, and error items, as well as detailed migration stats.

classes.name: UserMigrationStatus
classes.description: A class that tracks and reports the status of a user migration process, including counters, details, and string representation for reporting.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns an array of migration detail objects.

methods.name: isMigrated
methods.description: Checks if the migration has been completed successfully without errors and not a dry run.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Returns whether the current process is a dry run.

methods.name: setDryRun
methods.description: Sets the dry run mode for the migration process.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Adds a migration detail object and updates the counters.

methods.name: getProcessed
methods.description: Returns the total number of processed items.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the migration status and details.
